name: Hakuin Tenshi
source:
A young boy meets a kind, beautiful angel on the street. Just because he wants to be with her, he goes to the demon's place for how to keep the angel on the earth.
Rape the angel......this is what the demon tells him to make her stay on the earth......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE028563.html]DLsite English[/url]]
